title.en: Guess the number: China's science month

title.zh: China's science month draws billions with theme of innovation
title.en: China's science month draws billions with theme of innovation

note: The '10 billion people' figure is not used until its exact wording is checked.

text.zh: 科普月期间，全国举办了超过 36 万场科普活动。
text.en: More than 360,000 science activities were held during the month.

facts.quote: more than 360,000 science popularization activities were held across the country

text.zh: 超过 200 万名科学家和工程师参与其中。
text.en: Over 2 million scientists and engineers took part.

facts.quote: with over 2 million scientists and engineers participating

text.zh: 截至 2025 年底，全国共有 1988 家科技馆和科学类博物馆。
text.en: By the end of 2025, China had 1,988 science and technology museums and science-themed museums.

facts.quote: by the end of 2025, the country had 1,988 science and technology museums and science-themed museums

text.zh: 建设重心向中西部和基层倾斜，其中包括 204 家乡镇科技馆。
text.en: Building is shifting to central, western and grassroots areas, including 204 township museums.

facts.quote: with 204 township museums forming part of that rebalancing

text.zh: 去年全国共有 225 万名专兼职科普工作者。
text.en: Last year China had 2.25 million full-time and part-time science communication workers.

facts.quote: Last year, China had 2.25 million full-time and part-time science communication workers.

text.zh: 2025 年，18 至 69 岁公民中具备科学素质的比例为 17%。
text.en: In 2025, 17 percent of citizens aged 18 to 69 had attained scientific literacy.

facts.quote: In 2025, 17 percent of Chinese citizens aged between 18 and 69 years old had attained scientific literacy

prompt.zh: 科普月期间，全国举办了约多少场科普活动？
prompt.en: About how many science activities were held during the month?

prompt.zh: 有多少名科学家和工程师参与？
prompt.en: How many scientists and engineers took part?

prompt.zh: 截至 2025 年底，全国有多少家科技馆和科学类博物馆？
prompt.en: How many science and technology museums did China have at the end of 2025?

prompt.zh: 其中有多少家乡镇科技馆？
prompt.en: How many township museums are part of the shift to grassroots areas?

prompt.zh: 去年全国有多少名专兼职科普工作者？
prompt.en: How many full- and part-time science communicators did China have last year?

prompt.zh: 2025 年，18 至 69 岁公民中具备科学素质的比例是多少？
prompt.en: In 2025, what share of citizens aged 18–69 had attained scientific literacy?

intro.zh: 九月是全国科普月。移动滑块，猜一猜报道中的数字：越接近，得分越高。共 6 题，每题最高 100 分。
intro.en: September is China's National Science Popularization Month. Move the slider to guess the numbers from the story: the closer you are, the more points you score. 6 rounds, up to 100 points each.
